remaining_structural_obligations: Host Arguments use natural metadata; arbitrary Python types, negative dimensions/blocks/tuning remain outside the Lean host domain. Source probes confirm some negative blocks pass assertions and reach negative-grid or invalid-block dispatch.

Native allocation failure behavior, fresh physical separation, contiguous fp32 cells and tensor-to-region/byte-memory/ABI representation remain unbound. Kernel correctness quantifies all produced words, requiring no RNG distribution law.
Address bounds and output/K coverage are proved for natural element indices. Fixed-width sizes, intermediate overflow, storage representation and native pointer correspondence remain open.
Native block/arange/resource legality, empty grids and zero-K specialization admission, and supported num_warps/num_stages remain open; Python accepts some non-power-of-two blocks and invalid tuning.

Arbitrary order of complete logical programs is proved only under A/output and B/output region separation. Physical allocation freshness, native byte aliases, GPU instruction/warp interleavings, data races and concurrent refinement remain unproved.
Source equality uses the existing full admitted TypedSource.original transcription. Static source comparison and wrapper AST probes do not constitute a verified Python compiler translation.
